attributes.problem: Donated food reaches partner pantries unevenly across the county, so fresh produce runs out early while surplus spoils in store back rooms.
attributes.suitability: The network has many interacting parts (donors, a warehouse, vans, volunteers and pantries), people as well as technology, exchanges with outside systems such as the health department and the road network, and stakeholders whose needs conflict, such as neighbors and early delivery shifts. It is large enough to model in SysML v2 and small enough for one term.
attributes.soi: The network’s collection, warehousing and delivery service that moves donated food from donors to partner pantries.

artifacts.title: Produce until closing
artifacts.description: Families using partner pantries need the delivery service to keep fresh produce on the pantry shelves until closing time.
artifacts.rationale: Families arriving after work currently find no produce left.

gates.message: The course checks for this item pass.

artifacts.title: Safe temperatures
artifacts.description: The county health department needs the network to keep donated food within safe temperature limits throughout collection, storage and delivery.
artifacts.rationale: Unsafe temperatures could make distributed food harmful.

gates.message: The course checks for this item pass.

artifacts.title: Collection before closing
artifacts.description: Grocery store donors need the collection service to collect surplus food at every store before it closes for the night.
artifacts.rationale: Surplus left overnight fills their storage space.

gates.message: The course checks for this item pass.

artifacts.title: Shifts within commitment
artifacts.description: Volunteer drivers need the delivery service to end each delivery shift within the two hours they signed up for, even when donations are heavy.
artifacts.rationale: Volunteers drop out when shifts overrun their commitment.

gates.message: The course checks for this item pass.

artifacts.title: Early warning of storage failure
artifacts.description: Warehouse staff need the network to warn them of a freezer failure within minutes, at any hour including weekends.
artifacts.rationale: Weekend failures currently spoil stored meat before anyone notices.

gates.message: The course checks for this item pass.

artifacts.title: Reach by district
artifacts.description: Funders need the network to show how much food reached each county district during every quarter.
artifacts.rationale: Grant renewals depend on evidence of reach across districts.

gates.message: The course checks for this item pass.

artifacts.title: Quiet early mornings
artifacts.description: Neighbors of the warehouse need the delivery service to keep loading noise within the limits agreed with the city, at night and early in the morning.
artifacts.rationale: Early loading currently wakes residents on Mill Street.

gates.message: The course checks for this item pass.

artifacts.title: Separated spoiled food
artifacts.description: The waste hauler needs the network to separate spoiled food from packaging whenever a load is handed over for composting.
artifacts.rationale: Mixed loads are refused at the composting site.

gates.message: The course checks for this item pass.

milestones.aiStatement: We used a chat assistant to brainstorm candidate stakeholders; we kept two (waste hauler, neighbors) after checking them against the life-cycle stages and rejected three that were systems, not stakeholders. No AI wrote any need statement.
